practiceHub.title: Practice
practiceHub.subtitle: Choose a task type to start a practice session with AI-generated stimuli and instant feedback.
practiceHub.mockTitle: All task types in PTE order
practiceHub.mockDesc: Strict timing enforced — no early stops on speaking tasks.
practiceHub.desc.read-aloud: Read an AI-generated passage aloud as clearly and naturally as possible.
practiceHub.desc.repeat-sentence: Listen to a sentence once, then repeat it verbatim.
practiceHub.desc.answer-short-question: Hear a factual question and give a brief spoken answer (1–3 words).
practiceHub.desc.personal-intro: Introduce yourself — background, studies, and goals. Unscored in PTE.
practiceHub.desc.describe-image: Study a chart, map, or diagram for 25s, then describe it aloud in detail.
practiceHub.desc.re-tell-lecture: Listen to a short AI-generated lecture, then re-tell it in your own words.
practiceHub.desc.summarize-written-text: Read a passage, then write a one-sentence summary (5–75 words).
practiceHub.desc.write-essay: Write a 200–300 word essay in response to a given question.
practiceHub.desc.write-from-dictation: Listen to a sentence, then type exactly what you heard.
practiceHub.desc.summarize-spoken-text: Listen to an academic passage, then write a 50–70 word summary.
practiceHub.desc.fill-in-the-blanks-list: Listen to a passage read aloud, then select the correct word for each blank.
practiceHub.desc.highlight-correct-summa: Listen to a passage, then choose the summary that best matches what you heard.
practiceHub.desc.fill-in-the-blanks: Read an academic passage and select the correct word from a dropdown for each blank.
practiceHub.desc.re-order-paragraphs: Drag shuffled paragraph tiles into the correct logical order.
practiceHub.desc.multiple-choice: Read a passage and select the one correct answer from five options.
practiceHub.theme.desc: Type a topic and every task card will generate themed stimuli.
practiceHub.targeted.desc: Task types where you need the most work, ranked by recent performance.
practiceHub.targeted.noHistory: Complete a few practice tasks to get personalised recommendations.
home.practiceCardDesc: Read Aloud, Repeat Sentence, Write Essay and all 15 PTE task types — each with AI feedback.
practiceTask.common.micDenied: Microphone access denied. Please allow microphone and try again.
practiceTask.common.recordingStartsAuto: Recording starts automatically when the timer reaches 0.
practiceTask.common.writingPassageText: Writing passage text and synthesizing speech
practiceTask.read-aloud.desc: Read the passage aloud as clearly and naturally as possible. You will have {prepTime}s to prepare, then {recordTime}s to read.
practiceTask.read-aloud.idleDesc: An AI-generated passage will appear. Study it during the preparation phase, then read it aloud when recording starts.
practiceTask.read-aloud.analyzingSubtitl: Running AI feedback and pronunciation assessment in parallel
practiceTask.repeat-sentence.desc: Listen to the sentence, then repeat it verbatim. You have {recordTime}s to respond.
practiceTask.repeat-sentence.idleDesc: A sentence will be read aloud by Azure TTS. Listen carefully, then repeat it exactly.
practiceTask.repeat-sentence.playThenRec: Play the sentence, then click Record to repeat it.
practiceTask.answer-short-question.desc: Listen to the question, then give a short spoken answer (1–3 words). {recordTime}s to respond.
practiceTask.answer-short-question.idleD: An AI-generated factual question will appear. Answer as briefly and accurately as possible.
practiceTask.answer-short-question.liste: Listen carefully, then answer in 1–3 words
practiceTask.personal-intro.desc: Unscored in PTE, but great for warming up. {prepTime}s prep, {recordTime}s to speak.
practiceTask.personal-intro.fixedPrompt: Please introduce yourself. Tell us about your background, studies or work, your English learning experience, and your goals. Speak naturally and clearly.
practiceTask.describe-image.desc: Study the image for {prepTime}s, then describe it in detail. You have {recordTime}s to speak.
practiceTask.describe-image.idleDesc: A chart, map, or diagram will appear. Study it during the preparation phase, then describe what you see when recording starts.
practiceTask.re-tell-lecture.desc: Listen to a short lecture, then re-tell it in your own words. You have {prepTime}s to prepare and {recordTime}s to respond.
practiceTask.re-tell-lecture.idleDesc: An AI-generated lecture will be synthesized as audio. Listen carefully, prepare for 10s, then re-tell the key points.
practiceTask.re-tell-lecture.writingLect: Writing lecture text and synthesizing speech
practiceTask.re-tell-lecture.afterLectur: After the lecture ends, you will have {prepTime}s to prepare, then {recordTime}s to re-tell it.
practiceTask.re-tell-lecture.listenTimer: Listen carefully. The preparation timer starts when the lecture ends.
practiceTask.summarize-written-text.desc: Read the passage, then write a one-sentence summary (5–75 words). 10 minutes.
practiceTask.summarize-written-text.idle: An AI-generated passage will appear. Write a one-sentence summary capturing the main idea.
practiceTask.summarize-written-text.summ: Must be a single complete sentence.
practiceTask.summarize-written-text.empt: Please write your summary before submitting.
practiceTask.write-essay.desc: Write a {minWords}–{maxWords} word essay in response to the prompt. 20 minutes.
practiceTask.write-essay.idleDesc: An AI-generated essay question will appear. Write a structured {minWords}–{maxWords} word response.
practiceTask.write-essay.emptyEssayError: Please write your essay before submitting.
practiceTask.write-essay.essayPlaceholde: Write your essay here. Aim for {minWords}–{maxWords} words with a clear structure: introduction, body paragraphs, conclusion.
practiceTask.write-from-dictation.desc: Listen to the sentence, then type exactly what you heard. Every word counts.
practiceTask.write-from-dictation.idleDe: An AI-generated sentence will be read aloud. Type exactly what you hear — word for word.
practiceTask.write-from-dictation.listen: Listen carefully — you can only play once
practiceTask.write-from-dictation.typing: Typing will begin automatically after the sentence plays.
practiceTask.write-from-dictation.doNotR: Do not replay. Type every word exactly as spoken.
practiceTask.write-from-dictation.pressE: Press Enter or click Submit when done.
practiceTask.summarize-spoken-text.desc: Listen to a short academic passage, then write a 50–70 word summary. You have 10 minutes to write.
practiceTask.summarize-spoken-text.idleD: An AI-generated academic passage will be synthesized as audio. Listen carefully, then write a concise 50–70 word summary.
practiceTask.summarize-spoken-text.summa: Write a 50–70 word summary of the passage you heard.
practiceTask.summarize-spoken-text.after: After the passage ends, you will have 10 minutes to write your summary.
practiceTask.summarize-spoken-text.liste: Listen carefully. The writing timer starts when the passage ends.

practiceTask.highlight-correct-summary.d: Listen to a passage, then select the summary that best matches what you heard. 5 minutes.
practiceTask.highlight-correct-summary.i: An AI-generated passage will be read aloud. After listening, select the one summary that accurately captures the main idea and key points.
practiceTask.highlight-correct-summary.a: After the passage ends, you will choose the correct summary from 5 options.
practiceTask.highlight-correct-summary.l: Focus on the main idea and key points.
practiceTask.highlight-correct-summary.w: Which summary best captures what the passage was about?
practiceTask.fill-in-the-blanks.desc: Read the passage and select the correct word from the dropdown for each blank. 7 minutes.
practiceTask.fill-in-the-blanks.idleDesc: An AI-generated academic passage will appear with blanks. Choose the best word for each gap from the dropdown options.
practiceTask.re-order-paragraphs.desc: Drag the paragraph tiles into the correct logical order. 3 minutes.
practiceTask.re-order-paragraphs.idleDes: Shuffled paragraph tiles will appear. Drag them or use the arrows to arrange them in the correct order.
practiceTask.multiple-choice.desc: Read the passage and select the one correct answer from the five options. 4 minutes.
practiceTask.multiple-choice.idleDesc: An AI-generated passage with a comprehension question will appear. Read carefully and select the best answer.
